## Experience

### Software Engineer — Skillablers Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Jun 2025 — May 2026 · 1 year · Bangalore

- Built SurveyBot: a real-time conversational survey agent on LiveKit with sub-1-second response latency using Sarvam and Gemini models.
- Designed & deployed an on-premise Bhagavad Gita RAG system using Ollama-served LLMs (zero external API calls, <2s cached response).
- Engineered self-hosted AI infra (Ollama behind LiteLLM proxy, Kokoro, edge-tts, MMS-TTS Odia) and an IndicDLP e-paper digitization platform.
- Developed Flutter face-recognition pipeline (Google ML Kit + MobileFaceNet TFLite), EfficientNet image similarity, YOLO proctoring, and LLM features for Beyond Resume.
